# Security report notice

**Do not submit vulnerability details in this public issue.** Close this draft and follow the private reporting process in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md). If you accidentally exposed a credential, revoke it immediately and report only the minimum non-sensitive context through the private channel.

Public issues are appropriate only for ordinary bugs that do not create a security risk. Never include exploit payloads, tokens, private keys, authorization headers, private Telegram data, or personal information here.
